note: Machine-readable provenance for the Visualizer 2.0 engine. One entry per repository, keyed to a MASTER_PLAN.md §3.1 ledger row. Every licence hash below was read from the licence file at the recorded commit, not from a repository badge. Intended input for the checkEngineProvenance Gradle task (§3.3, slice V2-1-04); EngineProvenanceRegistryTest validates it today.

tiers.ADAPT: Per-file code adaptation permitted after licence verification, with SPDX and origin markers, shipped notices and a statement of modifications.
tiers.REIMPLEMENT: Published algorithms may be implemented and validated independently. No code, shader text, constant table, name or layout is copied.
tiers.ORACLE: Used outside the shipped runtime to generate fixtures and expected values. Never shipped, never linked.
tiers.BENCHMARK: Adoption candidate pending a measured win and an ADR. Nothing enters the tree before that evidence exists.
tiers.RETAIN: Already shipped and stays, under its existing boundary and obligations. Not a foundation for new engine code.
tiers.STUDY: Read for architecture and behaviour. Nothing derived from it enters the tree.
tiers.EXCLUDE: Licence, provenance, duplication or product fit blocks use. Mathematics research only.
